days.markdown:
- Wake up whenever and drive to Albuquerque. 3h28m++ {{Earlier the better if wanting to find campsite before dark.}} {{But if buffer day hasn't been used, can also take as much time as we want or end the day early and do Meow Wolf the next day, staying in Santa Fe.}}
- **Breaking Bad self-guided tour!** 🐸🦔
    - See [Abi's Map](https://www.google.com/maps/d/u/2/edit?mid=1HCgGGtPsX4R2VSpXHL10pRdFA7hX118&usp=sharing) for filming locations.
- Assemble Breaking Bad photo costume and props; buy anything needed!
- Head to [First Cook Site](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wUsr8dgAzsUDKpgN8) to take the **Walter White photo!** 🐸 40m++
- Head to Santa Fe for **Meow Wolf** by 6pm! 🐸 (Closes 8pm.) 57m++
    - **Note: We have a buffer day. We can take our time and do ABQ / Sante Fe over 2 days if we want. See Day 7's notes.**
- Overnight at [Santa Fe BLM Dispersed Campsite](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MWXp8DMpQfkauiyLA) ([dyrt](https://thedyrt.com/camping/new-mexico/santa-fe-blm)). 16m++
    - **More stargazing!** 🌠🐸🦔

If we decide to take our time in ABQ:
- ABQ BioPark Botanic Garden (has orchids and aquariums!)

- TODO: Depending on what we did the previous days and how early we start, we might have time here for half-day adventure somewhere in the area!
- Park the RV at [Bayfield-Durango Dispersed](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LihgcyMY3dyfPGSR8) ([dyrt](https://thedyrt.com/camping/colorado/blm-bayfiled-durango)). {{"Going east from Durango, you make a right turn on silver hills road. You will see the blm sign. Gravel road, fire pits."}}
- Uber to Durango Airport and pick up our rental car ~7pm but fine to be late, just call.
    - Confirmation #74406939. $73 pay at counter.
    - TODO: Save backup car services.

### Mesa Verde Day! 🐸🦔
- **No cell service at Mesa Verde!**
- 6:45a: Wake up and pack for day.
    - Don't forget!
        - Phones
        - IDs & Cards
        - Tickets
        - iPhone & Tripod & Power Bank & Cables
        - Food & Water
        - Pin location of RV on Maps
- 7:15a: Depart Bayfield-Durango Dispersed. 60m++
- 8:15a: Arrive at Visitor & Research Center.
- 8:30a: Drive to Long House. 90m++
- 10:00a: Arrive at Long House, 15m early for 10:15a briefing. {{"From the park entrance, drive 90 minutes/15 miles (24.1 km) to the turn for Wetherill Mesa (on your right, between the Far View Lodge and the Far View Terrace). Drive 12 miles (19.3 km) to reach the Wetherill Mesa parking lot. Meet the ranger at the trailhead to Long House, a 0.75 mile (1.2 km) walk from the parking lot. Allow 15-20 minutes to walk to the trailhead. You MUST arrive 15 minutes early for a safety and logistics briefing. Vehicles over 25 feet (8 m) and 8,000 lbs (3,628 kg) GVW are not allowed on the Wetherill Mesa Road. Allow at least 1.5 hours to drive to the Wetherill Mesa parking lot from the park entrance."}}
- 10:30a: **Long House!** 🐸🦔
    - ~12:25p-12:45p: Expected end.
- Drive to Cliff Palace. 40m++
- Lunch. (Maybe somewhere scenic on the Cliff Palace loop.)
- 2:30p: Meet at Cliff Palace Overlook for 2:45p briefing. {{"The tour starts 75 minutes from the park entrance at the Cliff Palace Overlook. From the park entrance, drive 20 miles (32.2 km) to the all-way stop on Chapin Mesa. Turn left. Drive 0.4 miles (0.6 km) and turn left onto the Cliff Palace Loop. Drive 1.7 miles (2.7 km) to the Cliff Palace parking lot. To arrive on time, allow 75 minutes to drive to Cliff Palace from the park entrance. Meet the ranger at the Cliff Palace Overlook, a 120 yard (110 meters) walk from the parking lot. You MUST arrive 15 minutes early for a safety and logistics briefing."}}
- 3:00p: **Cliff Palace!** 🐸🦔
    - ~3:45p-4:30p: Expected end.
- Relax after! Free day. Other lookouts. Or go somewhere else or get back to the RV 1h40m++ to shower and rest. Maybe go out for **dinner with the rental car before returning at Durango Airport by whatever time we started the reservation.**

- Drive to **Telluride**! 2h20m++
    - [Carhenge Lot](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5LGw3KAd5S3YYgqg8). Free all-day parking.
    - [Shandoka Lot](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xXiDsgj8L8iPmvGX8). Free all-day parking, a little further out.
- TODO: We have the whole day at Telluride. What should we do? Gondola, hot springs, etc.
- Leave Telluride to stay at [Electric Hills Trailhead](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VUiovqcEVWfFt1Xg7) ([dyrt](https://thedyrt.com/camping/colorado/90-rd-dispersed)). 1h32m++
